Class WhoProperties.Sessions

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.autoconfigure.WhoProperties.Sessions
Enclosing class:
WhoProperties
public static class WhoProperties.Sessions extends Object
who's record of browser sessions, which lets a person see where they are signed in and end a session. How long a session lasts without a request is Spring Boot's setting ( spring.session.timeout, else server.servlet.session.timeout), not who's.
